findings.summary: CreatePlanExitPreview manually derives swapInstruction from exitIntent, violating the release-blocker invariant that directional mapping must not be re-derived outside of DirectionalExitPolicyService.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a function to DirectionalExitPolicyService to map ExitIntentPosture to a swap instruction and execution skeleton, and use it in CreatePlanExitPreview.

findings.summary: CreatePlanExitPreview fabricates a fake previewId (`${currentPlan.planId}-preview`) when reusing a fresh preview, which will cause downstream lookups to fail if the repository generated a different ID.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `previewId` to the `exit-previewed` state in `PositionPlan.ts` so it can be stored and returned correctly when the preview is reused.

findings.summary: ApprovePlanExit performs database writes (saveAttempt, savePreparedPayload) before calling applyPlanLifecycleTransition. If the state transition is invalid, an error is thrown, leaving orphaned records in the database.
findings.suggested_fix: Call applyPlanLifecycleTransition to validate the transition before performing any database writes.

findings.summary: ApprovePlanExit throws an error instead of being idempotent when the plan is already in an executable state (e.g. 'awaiting-signature'), violating the suggested fix from the previous review.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `attemptId` to the `awaiting-signature` and `submitted` states in PositionPlan so it can be returned idempotently instead of throwing an error.
